_comment: CloudWatch agent config for the dashboard box.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: before 2026-07-27 this agent collected exactly ONE
metric -- disk used_percent -- on a box whose own watchdog script documents
RAM as the binding constraint ('the binding constraint is RAM, not CPU',
box_health.sh line 5). The consequence was demonstrated twice in three days:
metron-refresh was OOM-killed on 2026-07-25 and nothing alerted, and on
2026-07-27 the box cascaded into an unmanageable state (MemAvailable 44 MB,
metron-dash down, SSM agent starved) with no CloudWatch signal at any point.
There was no memory metric to alarm on.
The config also lived only on the box. It is version-controlled here so a
NAMESPACE: AlphaEngine/Host. The previous namespace was AlphaEngine/HostDisk,
which stopped being accurate the moment this collected anything but disk.
Alarms were migrated in the same change.
